spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अर्दति)
1 To ask or beg.
2 To go.
1st and 10th cls. (अर्दति-ते अर्दयति-ते)
To kill or to hurt.

f. (-ना)
1 Begging, asking.
2 Giving pain.
3

Killing.
4

Going.
E.
अर्द to ask, &c. युच् and टाप् affs.

Fire.
2

Asking, begging.
3 Sickness, disease.
E.
अर्द to pain, इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Asked, requested, begged.
2 Killed, injured.
3 Pained, afflicted.
4 Gone.
n. (-तं)
A disease, Hemiplegia, paralysis of the muscles on one side of the face and neck.
E.
अर्द to go, to ask, &c. affix, क्त and इट् inserted.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं)
Half, halved.
m. (-र्द्धं)
A part.
n. (-र्द्धं)
A half.
E.
ऋध to increase, and घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Halved, divided equally.
E.
अर्द्ध, and कृत made.

nf. (-रं-री)
A measure, half a khārī.
E.
अर्द्धं, and खारी a measure so called.

f. (-ङ्गा)
The Kāverī river, in the peninsula.
E.
अर्द्ध half, and गङ्गा the Ganges; being a sacred stream, having half the virtues of the great Ganges.

m. (-च्छः)
A necklace of twenty-four strings.
E.
अर्द्ध, and गुच्छ a bundle.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 A crescent or half moon.
2 The hand bent into a semicircle or the shape of a claw, as for the purpose of seizing or clutching any thing.
3 The semicircular marks on a peacock's tail.
4 An arrow, with a head like a crescent.
5 The semicircular scratch of the finger nail.
f. (-न्द्रा)
A plant, vulgarly Teori, the black kind.
E.
अर्द्ध half, and चन्द्र moon, or with कन् added अर्द्धचन्द्रकः.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Of the shape of the half moon.
m. (रः)
A meniscus.
E.
अर्द्धचन्द्र, and आकार form.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Half mooned, of a crescent-shape, convex and concave.
f. (-तिः)
A meniscus.
E.
अर्द्धचन्द्र, and आकृति shape.

m. (-कः)
A short bodice.
E.
अर्द्ध, and चोलक a bodice.

f. (-वी)
The Kāverī river. See अर्द्धगङ्ग, जाह्नवी being the Ganges.

n. (रं)
A knife or lancet with a single edge, the blade two inches long, the heft six.
E.
अर्द्ध, and धारा an edge.

m. (-शः)
A name of MAHĀDEVA.
E.
अर्द्ध, नारी a woman, and ईश master; one of the forms of ŚIVA, to which this name applies, being half male and half female.

m. (-वः)
A boat's half.
E.
अर्द्ध, and नाव, from नौ a boat, and टच् aff.

f. (-शा)
Midnight.
E.
अर्द्ध, and निशा night.

n. (-णं)
Half a Paṇa.
E.
अर्द्ध, and पण a measure of four Kākiṇīs.

m. (-तः)
1 A pigeon, (with a spotted or painted throat.)
2 The francoline partridge.
E.
अर्द्ध, and पारावत a pigeon.

n. (-तं)
A half gallop, a canter.
E.
अर्द्ध, and पुलायित a gallop.

m. (-रः)
Half a watch, a period of an hour and a half.
E.
अर्द्ध, and प्रहर a watch.

m. (-गः)
A half.
E.
अर्द्ध, and भाग part.

mf. (भाक्)
Taking or sharing half.
E.
अर्द्ध half, and भाज who possesses.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Taking or sharing half.
E.
अर्द्धभाग a half, ठक aff.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Sharing or taking half.
E.
अर्द्धभाग and इनि aff.

m. (-वः)
A necklace of twelve strings. Also अर्द्धमाणवक.
E.
अर्द्ध, and माणव one of twenty-four strings.

m. (-मः)
Half a watch, an hour and a half.
E.
अर्द्ध, and याम a watch, also अर्द्धयामक.

m. (-थः)
A warrior, who fights on a car with another.
E.
अर्द्ध, and रथ a car, having half a car.

Midnight.
2

The period from two and a half to three and a half watches of the night.
E.
अर्द्ध, and रात्र night.

mn. (-र्चः-र्चं)
Half a verse of the Vedas.
E.
अर्द्ध, and ऋच् a verse of a Veda.

n. (-णं)
A side look, a glance, a leer.
E.
अर्द्ध, and वीक्षण looking.

Fifty.
2

One hundred and fifty.
E.
अर्द्ध, and शत a hundred, in the second sense it is more usually सार्द्ध शत, &c. So अर्द्धपञ्चाशत्, अर्द्धसहस्र, &c.

n. (-नं)
Half a meal.
E.
अर्द्ध, and अशन eating, also अर्द्धाशन.

n. (-नं)
Half a meal. Also अर्द्धशन.

n. (-नं)
1 Exemption from censure.
2 Greeting kindly or with respect, placing on the same seat.
E.
अर्द्ध, and आस to remain, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-रः)
A small fish, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM.)
E.
अर्द्ध, and सफर another fish, to which it is compared.

m. (-री)
A cultivator, a ploughman who takes half the crop for his labour.
E.
अर्द्ध, and सीर a plough, इनि aff.

m. (-रः)
A necklace of sixty-four strings.
E.
अर्द्ध, and हार a necklace.

m. (-शः)
A half.
E.
अर्द्ध, and अंश a share.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Sharing a half.
E.
अर्द्धांश and इनि aff.

n. (-ङ्गः)
Half the body.
E.
अर्द्ध, and अङ्ग the body.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं)
Sharing equally.
m. (-र्द्धः)
A quarter.
E.
अर्द्ध repeated.

m. (-कः)
Pain of half the head, hemicrania.
n. (-कं)
Dividing in equal parts.
E.
अर्द्ध, and अवभेदक cutting off.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Measuring a half.
2 Relating to a half.
E.
अर्द्ध and टिठन aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Sharing half, an equal partner.
2 Relating to half.
m. (-कः)
One who ploughs the ground for half the crop.
E.
अर्द्ध half, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिणी-र्द्धि)
Entitled to or sharing a half.
E.
अर्द्ध and इनि aff.

m. (-न्दुः)
1 A half moon or crescent.
2 The impression of a finger nail.
3 The hand expanded in a semicircular form like a claw.
4 An arrow with a crescent-shaped head.
E.
अर्द्धे, and इन्दु the moon.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Half uttered, said imperfectly or indistinctly.
E.
अर्द्ध, and उक्त said.

f. (-क्तिः)
Speaking indistinctly or incompletely, broken or interrupted speech.
E.
अर्द्ध, and उक्ति speech.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Half risen.
2 Half uttered.
E.
अर्द्ध, and उदित risen.

n. (-कं)
A short petticoat.
E.
अर्द्ध, and उरु the thigh, कन् aff.

mfn. (-र्द्रः-र्द्रा-र्द्रं)
1 Wet, moist, damp.
2 Fresh, not dry.
3 Loose, flaccid.
4 Tender, soft.
f. (र्द्रा)
The sixth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.
E.
अद to go, रक् Uṇādi affix, and the pen. lengthened.

n. (-कं)
Ginger in the undried state.
E.
आर्द्र moist, and वुन् aff.

n. (-ष्ठं)
Green wood, timber not dry.
E.
आर्द्र and काष्ठ wood.

f. (-ता)
1 Moisture, wetness.
2 Tenderness, softness.
3 Freshness, greenness.
E.
आर्द्र and तल् affix; also आद्रत्वं.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Weeping, suffused with tears.
E.
आद्र and नयन the eye.

f. (-षा)
A leguminous shrub, (Glycine debilis.)
E.
आर्द्र moist, and माष a sort of bean.

n. (-कं)
Ginger.
E.
आर्द्र and शाक a potherb.

m. (-कः)
The dragon's tail or descending node.
E.
आर्द्रा the lunar mansion, and लुब्धक who desires.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Bought with half a Droṇa, containing it, &c.
E.
अर्द्ध, द्रोण a measure, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging to a part of a verb, (the inflexions of six tenses.)
E.
अर्द्ध and धातु a root, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Bought, &c. with half a Prastha.
E.
अर्द्धप्रस्थ a measure, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Lasting, &c. for half a month.
2 Observing or practising (Continence, &c.) for a fortnight.
E.
आर्द्धमास and ठञ् aff.
